scenario.name: board-a-5v-fused-link-drop
scenario.description: DC drop across the fused 5 V entry link's copper at 100 mA. SUBSTITUTIONS, stated: the host supply is an ideal 5 V source; the downstream demand is a 50 ohm resistor drawing 100 mA at 5 V. The fuse and diode are NOT modeled and nothing here claims them.

provenance.resistivity_source: IEC 60028 international annealed copper standard, 20 C
provenance.two_terminal_asserted_by: scenario author; verified on this board: 5V_FUSED carries exactly pads F1.2 and D1.2

omissions: temperature dependence beyond the 20 C resistivity reference
notes: the series sum of per-segment DC resistances: equal to the two-terminal DC resistance only for an unbranched net; for a branched net it is a copper inventory metric, and no two-terminal claim is made
